name: Dazalar
summary: In Dolanaar, Dazalar prepares young night elf hunters for Teldrassil's wilds. He teaches steady aim and bonds with the beasts of the great boughs.

sections.title: The Dolanaar Encampment
sections.body: After leaving Shadowglen, young hunters train with Dazalar in Dolanaar. Night elf rangers and sentinels patrol the wilderness, so he teaches the patience and discipline needed to protect Teldrassil's fragile ecosystem.

sections.title: Bonding with the Wild
sections.body: Dazalar teaches hunters to tame and care for beasts. The Kaldorei seek a pact with forest predators such as nightsabers, owls, and strigid hunters. Their companions learn to fight beside them through respect, not force.

faq.answer: Dazalar trains night elf hunters in Dolanaar. He teaches combat skills and how to tame wild beasts.
You can find Dazalar outdoors in Dolanaar, Teldrassil's central hub, shortly after leaving Shadowglen.
Dazalar teaches ranged attacks, traps, and survival skills. He guides novice hunters through trials to master taming wilderness animals.

faq.q: Does Dazalar offer any special quests?
faq.answer: Yes. Dazalar offers hunter training that includes The Hunter's Path, the multi-part trial Taming the Beast, and Training the Beast. These teach young hunters to bond with and care for animal companions.

faq.q: Why do night elves rely so heavily on hunters?
faq.answer: Night elves have lived in harmony with Kalimdor's ancient forests for millennia. Archers and scouts form the backbone of the Sentinel army. They use stealth, marksmanship, and animal allies to protect their lands without disrupting nature.

faq.q: What kind of beasts does Dazalar send hunters to tame?
faq.answer: Dazalar sends hunters to find native Teldrassil beasts, including local spiders, nightsabers, and birds of prey. The trials test their ability to approach and calm wild predators.

angles.text: As a hunter, Dazalar guides you through your first trials in beast mastery and caring for an animal companion.
As a night elf, you learn the Kaldorei traditions of sentinels and scouts, and how to live in balance with nature's fierce predators.
